description.text: TEDC is first and foremost a road to loan capital for your business, we also provide the necessary resources that empower you to succeed.

targetApplicants.text: In today’s economic climate, most small businesses can benefit from TEDC’s menu of loan programs. Special consideration is given to companies that create and retain jobs, to businesses located in special targeted areas, and to entrepreneurs who have traditionally faced barriers to capital access.
